ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels, with the majority of the surface area exhibiting values below the 20th percentile of brightness.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels are concentrated in the distal 25% of both lobes, forming dense, irregular mottling and linear striations. The proximal and central 75% of the fluke surface is composed of contiguous low-intensity black pixels with minimal variance.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees at the vertex where the inner lobe boundaries intersect.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations. The right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with three distinct deep-pixel valleys between the mid-lobe and the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves along the proximal leading edges, transitioning into a steep concave upward sweep toward the distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel groupings are visible along the perimeter of the distal tips, specifically on the dorsal-most edges of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions are visible within the pigmented distal regions, particularly on the left lobe, cutting across the primary mottling patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced, irregular jagged loss of material along the trailing edge of the right lobe, appearing as three major step-like indentations relative to the expected smooth contour.
